```{r include=FALSE}
################################################################################
```

The following packages are loaded in the session, and need to be installed to run the R code:

```{r packages, message=FALSE}
library(readr); library(dlnm) ; library(gnm) ; library(data.table) ; library(splines); 
library(MASS);  library(ggcorrplot); library(dplyr); library(car);library(tidyr);
library(lme4);  library(kableExtra)
```


```{r datos, warning = FALSE,}
Datosdengueclima <- read_csv("data/caribe_data/Datosdengueclimav.csv")

datos_dlnm=Datosdengueclima
datos_dlnm <- datos_dlnm[datos_dlnm$Año >= 2009 & datos_dlnm$Año <= 2023, ]
datos_dlnm$Fecha <- as.Date(paste(datos_dlnm$Año, datos_dlnm$Semana_Epidemiologica, 1, 
                                  sep = "-"), 
                            format = "%Y-%U-%u")
```

Now, with the function `crossbasis()` a time-distributed transformation is parameterised to study the relationship between environmental exposures (temperature, precipitation and humidity) and dengue cases. 

```{r include=FALSE}
################################################################################
# Creation of cross-bases
################################################################################
```


```{r include=FALSE}
# Función
obtener_aic_ns <- function(variables, datos, casos, df_max = 4) {
  
  resultados_aic <- data.frame(Variable = character(), df = integer(), AIC = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    for (variable in variables) {
    for (df in 1:df_max) {
      formula <- as.formula(paste(casos, "~ ns(", variable, ", df =", df, ")"))
      modelo <- lm(formula, data = datos)
      aic_val <- AIC(modelo)  # Calcular el AIC del modelo
      resultados_aic <- rbind(resultados_aic, data.frame(Variable = variable, df = df, AIC = aic_val))
    }
  }
    return(resultados_aic)
}

# Llamar a la función con las variables
aic_tempave <- obtener_aic_ns("BAQ_avg_temperature", datos_dlnm, "Casos_Barranquilla")
aic_tempmin <- obtener_aic_ns("BAQ_min_temperature", datos_dlnm, "Casos_Barranquilla")
aic_tempmax <- obtener_aic_ns("BAQ_max_temperature", datos_dlnm, "Casos_Barranquilla")
aic_humrel <- obtener_aic_ns("BAQ_avg_relative_humidity", datos_dlnm, "Casos_Barranquilla")
aic_humesp <- obtener_aic_ns("BAQ_avg_specific_humidity", datos_dlnm, "Casos_Barranquilla")
aic_prectot <- obtener_aic_ns("BAQ_total_precipitation", datos_dlnm, "Casos_Barranquilla")

```


```{r crossbasis_bqlla}
cb_temp_ave_bql<- crossbasis(
                  datos_dlnm$BAQ_avg_temperature, 
                  lag = 24, # Up to 24 weeks lags
                  argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = 3), # Non-linear relationship with temperature
                  arglag = list(fun = "poly", degree = 2) # Non-linear relationship with lags
                )

cb_temp_max_bql<- crossbasis(
                  datos_dlnm$BAQ_max_temperature, 
                  lag = 24, 
                  argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = 3), 
                  arglag = list(fun = "poly", degree = 2) 
                )

cb_temp_min_bql<- crossbasis(
                  datos_dlnm$BAQ_min_temperature, 
                  lag = 24, 
                  argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = 3), 
                  arglag = list(fun = "poly", degree = 2) 
                )

cb_hum_rel_bql<- crossbasis(
                  datos_dlnm$BAQ_avg_relative_humidity, 
                  lag = 24,
                  argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = 3), 
                  arglag = list(fun = "poly", degree = 2) 
                )

cb_hum_esp_bql<- crossbasis(
                  datos_dlnm$BAQ_avg_specific_humidity, 
                  lag = 24,
                  argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = 3), 
                  arglag = list(fun = "poly", degree = 2) 
                )

cb_prec_tot_bql<- crossbasis(
                  datos_dlnm$BAQ_total_precipitation, 
                  lag = 24,
                  argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = 3), 
                  arglag = list(fun = "poly", degree = 2) 
                )

```


Now, with all terms parameterised, a negative binomial regression is fitted excluding variables that were highly correlated, as follows:

```{r model_bql}
# Modelo bn0: Todas las 6 variables
mod_bql_0 <- glm.nb(Casos_Barranquilla ~ cb_temp_ave_bql +
                                         cb_temp_max_bql +
                                         cb_temp_min_bql +
                                         cb_hum_rel_bql  + 
                                         cb_hum_esp_bql  +
                                         cb_prec_tot_bql +
                                         ns(Semana_Epidemiologica, df = 7) + # Seasonal adjustment 
                                         factor(Año), # Trend by year
                                       data=datos_dlnm)

vif(mod_bql_0)

# Modelo bn1: excluyendo temp.media y hum.especifica
mod_bql_1 <- glm.nb(Casos_Barranquilla ~ cb_temp_max_bql +
                                         cb_temp_min_bql +
                                         cb_hum_rel_bql  + 
                                         cb_prec_tot_bql+
                                         ns(Semana_Epidemiologica, df = 7) +  
                                         factor(Año), 
                                      data=datos_dlnm)

vif(mod_bql_1)


# Modelo bn1: excluyendo temp.media, temp.minima y hum.especifica
mod_bql_2 <- glm.nb(Casos_Barranquilla ~ cb_temp_max_bql +
                                         cb_hum_rel_bql  + 
                                         cb_prec_tot_bql +
                                         ns(Semana_Epidemiologica, df = 7) + 
                                         factor(Año), 
                                      data=datos_dlnm)

vif(mod_bql_2)


# Modelo bn3: excluyendo todas las temp. y hum.especifica
mod_bql_3 <- glm.nb(Casos_Barranquilla ~ cb_hum_rel_bql  + 
                                         cb_prec_tot_bql +
                                         ns(Semana_Epidemiologica, df = 7) + 
                                         factor(Año), 
                                      data=datos_dlnm)

vif(mod_bql_3)

# Modelo bn4: prec.total con interacción entre temp.media y hum.relativa
mod_bql_4 <- glm.nb(Casos_Barranquilla ~ cb_temp_ave_bql +
                                         cb_hum_rel_bql  + 
                                         cb_prec_tot_bql +
                                         cb_temp_ave_bql:cb_hum_rel_bql +
                                         ns(Semana_Epidemiologica, df = 4) + 
                                         factor(Año),
                                      data=datos_dlnm)

# Modelo bn5: iprec.total con interacción entre temp. max y hum.relativa
mod_bql_5 <- glm.nb(Casos_Barranquilla ~ cb_temp_max_bql + 
                                         cb_hum_rel_bql  + 
                                         cb_prec_tot_bql +
                                         cb_temp_max_bql:cb_hum_rel_bql, 
                                       data = datos_dlnm)

# Modelo bn6: SOLO con la interacción entre temp. max y hum.relativa
mod_bql_6 <- glm.nb(Casos_Barranquilla ~ cb_temp_max_bql + 
                                         cb_hum_rel_bql  + 
                                         cb_temp_max_bql:cb_hum_rel_bql, 
                                       data = datos_dlnm)


pR2(mod_bql_0) #pR2: 0.216   AIC:5856      
pR2(mod_bql_1) #pR2: 0.193   AIC:5986.8    
pR2(mod_bql_2) #pR2: 0.181   AIC:6057.4    
pR2(mod_bql_3) #pR2: 0.160   AIC:6195.4    
pR2(mod_bql_4) #pR2: 0.261   AIC:5637.8  ** 
pR2(mod_bql_5) #pR2: 0.163   AIC:6309.4  xx
pR2(mod_bql_6) #pR2: 0.138   AIC:6473.1    


layout(matrix(c(1,2,3,4,5,6), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))
plot(residuals(mod_bql_0, type = "deviance"))
plot(residuals(mod_bql_1, type = "deviance")) 
plot(residuals(mod_bql_2, type = "deviance")) 
plot(residuals(mod_bql_3, type = "deviance")) 
plot(residuals(mod_bql_4, type = "deviance")) 
plot(residuals(mod_bql_5, type = "deviance")) 
plot(residuals(mod_bql_6, type = "deviance"))


#### OTRO MODELO
# library(pscl)
# mod_bql_zinb <- zeroinfl(Casos_Barranquilla ~ cb_temp_ave_bql +
#                                               cb_hum_rel_bql  + 
#                                               cb_prec_tot_bql +
#                                               cb_temp_ave_bql:cb_hum_rel_bql +
#                                               ns(Semana_Epidemiologica, df = 7) + 
#                                               factor(Año) | 1,                                                                  data = datos_dlnm, 
#                                             dist = "negbin") 
# 


mod_bql=mod_bql_4
```

Now, with `crosspred()`, we take the results of the model (the coefficients) and evaluate how these variables are related to dengue risk in different scenarios:

```{r crosspred_bql}
cptmean <- crosspred(
           basis = cb_temp_ave_bql, 
           model = mod_bql,  
           cen = mean(datos_dlnm$BAQ_avg_temperature, na.rm = TRUE), 
           by = 1)
names(coef(mod_bql))
# Verificar la dimensión de la base cruzada
dim(cb_temp_ave_bql)
# Verificar los coeficientes del modelo
length(coef(mod_bql))

cphrh <- crosspred(
         basis = cb_hum_rel_bql, 
         model = mod_bql, 
         cen = mean(datos_dlnm$BAQ_avg_relative_humidity, na.rm = TRUE),
         by = 0.5)

cpprecip <- crosspred(
            basis = cb_prec_tot_bql, 
            model = mod_bql, 
            cen = mean(datos_dlnm$BAQ_total_precipitation, na.rm = TRUE),
            by = 5 )

```


```{r include=FALSE}
################################################################################
# Associations with the coefficients of climatic variables
################################################################################
```

With the above, the association in both dimensions of exposure intensity and delay is plotted. Specifically, the following graphs represent the exposure responses (interpreted as the net associations taking into account the whole lag period), the full two-dimensional exposure-delay responses for non-linear temperature, humidity, precipitation and the lag response.

```{r plottempaver, out.width='100%', fig.dim=c(10,4), echo=-c(1,3,5,6)}

par(oma = c(0, 0, 5, 0))
layout(t(1:3))

plot(cptmean, 
     xlab="C°", 
     zlab="RR", 
     main="Temperature average",
     phi = 30, theta = 230) 

plot(cphrh, 
     xlab = "%", 
     zlab = "RR", 
     main = "Relative humidity", 
     phi = 30, theta = 230)

plot(cpprecip, 
     xlab = "PT", 
     zlab = "RR", 
     main = "Total precipitation", 
     phi = 30, theta = 230)

title(main = "Exposure-lag-response: Barranquilla", outer = TRUE)

```

```{r include=FALSE}
aic_tempave <- obtener_aic_ns("CTG_avg_temperature", datos_dlnm, "Casos_Cartagena")
aic_tempmin <- obtener_aic_ns("CTG_min_temperature", datos_dlnm, "Casos_Cartagena")
aic_tempmax <- obtener_aic_ns("CTG_max_temperature", datos_dlnm, "Casos_Cartagena")
aic_humrel <- obtener_aic_ns("CTG_avg_relative_humidity", datos_dlnm, "Casos_Cartagena")
aic_humesp <- obtener_aic_ns("CTG_avg_specific_humidity", datos_dlnm, "Casos_Cartagena")
aic_prectot <- obtener_aic_ns("CTG_total_precipitation", datos_dlnm, "Casos_Cartagena")

```


```{r crossbasis_stm}
cb_temp_ave_stm<- crossbasis(
                  datos_dlnm$SMR_avg_temperature, 
                  lag = 24, 
                  argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = 3), 
                  arglag = list(fun = "poly", degree = 2) 
                )

cb_hum_rel_stm<- crossbasis(
                  datos_dlnm$SMR_avg_relative_humidity, 
                  lag = 24,
                  argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = 3), 
                  arglag = list(fun = "poly", degree = 2) 
                )

cb_prec_tot_stm<- crossbasis(
                  datos_dlnm$SMR_total_precipitation, 
                  lag = 24,
                  argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = 3), 
                  arglag = list(fun = "poly", degree = 2) 
                )



```

Now, with all terms parameterised, a negative binomial regression is fitted as follows:

```{r model_stm}
mod_stm <- glm.nb(Casos_SantaMarta ~ cb_temp_ave_stm+
                                       cb_hum_rel_stm+
                                       cb_prec_tot_stm+
                                        ns(Semana_Epidemiologica, df = 7) + 
                                        factor(Año),          
                                      data=datos_dlnm)
vif(mod_stm)

pR2(mod_stm)
# Obtener residuos y valores ajustados
residuos <- residuals(mod_stm)
fitted_values <- fitted(mod_stm)

# Crear el gráfico usando ggplot2
ggplot(data = data.frame(fitted_values, residuos), aes(x = fitted_values, y = residuos)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Valores ajustados", y = "Residuos", title = "Gráfico de Residuos")
```


```{r crosspred__stm}
cptmean_stm <- crosspred(
                 basis = cb_temp_ave_stm, 
                 model = mod_stm,  
                 cen = mean(datos_dlnm$SMR_avg_temperature, na.rm = TRUE), 
                 by = 0.1)

cphrh_stm  <- crosspred(
               basis = cb_hum_rel_stm, 
               model = mod_stm,   
               at = seq(70, 100, by = 1), 
               cen = mean(datos_dlnm$SMR_avg_relative_humidity, na.rm = TRUE),
               by = 0.5 )

cpprecip_stm  <- crosspred(
                  basis = cb_prec_tot_stm, 
                  model = mod_stm,   
                  cen = mean(datos_dlnm$SMR_total_precipitation, na.rm = TRUE),
                  by = 5 )
```

```{r include=FALSE}
################################################################################
```


```{r plottempaver_stm, out.width='100%', fig.dim=c(10,4), echo=-c(1,3,5,6)}

par(oma = c(0, 0, 5, 0))
layout(t(1:3)) 

plot(cptmean_stm, 
     xlab="C°", 
     zlab="RR", 
     main="Temperature average",
     phi = 30, theta = 230) 

plot(cphrh_stm, 
     xlab = "%", 
     zlab = "RR", 
     main = "Relative humidity", 
     phi = 30, theta = 230)

plot(cpprecip_stm, 
     xlab = "PT", 
     zlab = "RR", 
     main = "Total precipitation", 
     phi = 30, theta = 230)
title(main = "Exposure-lag-response: Santa Marta", outer = TRUE)

```



### Todas las ciudades juntas

For this, a base called ‘data_final’ was consolidated, where the variables were not separated by city, but the city was indicated in a new variable called ‘city’.

```{r include=FALSE}
data <- datos_dlnm
data<-rename(data,BAQ_Casos=Casos_Barranquilla,CTG_Casos=Casos_Cartagena, SMR_Casos=Casos_SantaMarta)

# Paso 1: Transformar los datos al formato largo
data_long <- data %>%
  # Seleccionar las columnas relevantes
  select(Año, Semana_Epidemiologica,
         BAQ_Casos, CTG_Casos, SMR_Casos,
         BAQ_max_temperature, BAQ_min_temperature, BAQ_avg_temperature,
         BAQ_avg_specific_humidity, BAQ_avg_relative_humidity, BAQ_total_precipitation,
         CTG_max_temperature, CTG_min_temperature, CTG_avg_temperature,
         CTG_avg_specific_humidity, CTG_avg_relative_humidity, CTG_total_precipitation,
         SMR_max_temperature, SMR_min_temperature, SMR_avg_temperature,
         SMR_avg_specific_humidity, SMR_avg_relative_humidity, SMR_total_precipitation) %>%
  # Transformar las columnas de clima al formato largo
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(BAQ_Casos, CTG_Casos, SMR_Casos,
             BAQ_max_temperature, BAQ_min_temperature, BAQ_avg_temperature,
             BAQ_avg_specific_humidity, BAQ_avg_relative_humidity, BAQ_total_precipitation,
             CTG_max_temperature, CTG_min_temperature, CTG_avg_temperature,
             CTG_avg_specific_humidity, CTG_avg_relative_humidity, CTG_total_precipitation,
             SMR_max_temperature, SMR_min_temperature, SMR_avg_temperature,
             SMR_avg_specific_humidity, SMR_avg_relative_humidity, SMR_total_precipitation), # Columnas seleccionadas
    names_to = c("city", "variable"),  # Definir nuevos nombres de columna
    names_pattern = "([^_]+)_(.*)"  # Dividir en "city" (antes del primer "_") y "variable" (después del primer "_")
  )


# Paso 2: Separar cada variable en columnas distintas
data_wide <- data_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "variable", values_from = "value")


# Paso 3: Renombrar columnas para que coincidan con lo solicitado
data_final <- data_wide %>%
              rename(year = Año,
                     week = Semana_Epidemiologica,
                     dengue_cases = Casos,
                     temp_max = max_temperature,
                     temp_min = min_temperature,
                     temp_mean = avg_temperature,
                     humidity_mean_specific = avg_specific_humidity,
                     humidity_mean_relative = avg_relative_humidity,
                     precipitation = total_precipitation) %>%
              # Convertir `city` en factor
              mutate(city = factor(city))
```


```{r include=FALSE}
#==================================================================
# Examinar correlaciones entre variables climáticas (sin desfase)
#==================================================================
cor_matrix <- cor(data_final %>%
                    select(temp_max, temp_min, temp_mean, 
                           humidity_mean_relative, 
                           humidity_mean_specific, 
                           precipitation), 
                  use = "complete.obs")
print(cor_matrix)
```

```{r grah_todas_cor, out.width='60%', fig.dim=c(7,6), fig.align='center', echo=FALSE}
# Visualizar la matriz de correlación
library(ggcorrplot)
ggcorrplot(cor_matrix, hc.order = TRUE, type = "lower", lab = TRUE)
```

```{r crossbasis_todas}
cb_temp_mean <- crossbasis(data_final$temp_mean, 
                           lag = 24,
                           argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = 3),  
                           arglag = list(fun = "poly", degree = 2)   
                           )

cb_humidity_relative <- crossbasis(data_final$humidity_mean_relative, 
                                   lag = 24,
                                   argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = 3),
                                   arglag = list(fun = "poly", degree = 2)
                                   )

cb_precip <- crossbasis(data_final$precipitation, 
                        lag = 24,
                        argvar = list(fun = "ns", df = 3),
                        arglag = list(fun = "poly", degree = 2)
                        )
```


```{r model_todas}
model_bineg_1 <- glm.nb(dengue_cases ~ cb_temp_mean + 
                                        cb_humidity_relative + 
                                        cb_precip +
                                        ns(week, df = 7) + 
                                        factor(year) + 
                                        factor(city), 
                        data = data_final)

vif(model_bineg_1)
pR2(model_bineg_1)
# Obtener residuos y valores ajustados
residuos <- residuals(model_bineg_1)
fitted_values <- fitted(model_bineg_1)

# Crear el gráfico usando ggplot2
ggplot(data = data.frame(fitted_values, residuos), aes(x = fitted_values, y = residuos)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Valores ajustados", y = "Residuos", title = "Gráfico de Residuos")
```


```{r crosspred__todas}

                      basis = cb_precip,

                      cen = mean(data_final$precipitation, na.rm = TRUE),  
                      by = 5                 
                    )
```
